sections.sectionText: Business Pathways Academy Seminar is a graded 1- credit hour course for undergraduate College of Business students enrolled in the Business Pathways Academy. This course will cover wellness essentials for academically staying on track, engaging with community and building crucial skills.

Introduces students to the history, culture, and business environment of international destinations. Students will engage in company visits, lectures, and experiential opportunities to learn more about a variety of businesses and industries abroad.

sections.sectionText: Introduces T&M students to the history, culture, and business environment of international destinations. Students will engage in company visits, lectures, and experiential learning opportunities to learn more about a variety of businesses abroad from large corporations to NGOs to startups.

Introduces students to the history, culture, and business environment of international destinations. Students will engage in company visits, lectures, and experiential opportunities to learn more about a variety of businesses and industries abroad.

Provides Business in Action Senior Managers with an opportunity to reflect on their leadership experiences and engagement in the study abroad program. Through structured reflection, students will examine their leadership development, contributions to the program, and the application of leadership skills in an international context.
Open to all Students participating in Virtual Global Career Accelerator Program. This course requires an application. Apply here: https://www.careeraccelerator.illinois.edu/
